quickIndex.title: ROOM INDEX
headline: Everything in
the room.
quickIndex.description: Use this index if you want the portfolio without the scavenger hunt. The room and the files contain the same work.

computer.label: COMPUTER
computer.log: An active desktop contains projects, experience records, and one bulletin that does not belong.

drawer.label: DESK DRAWER
drawer.log: The drawer contains an EMG prototype, spare components, and labels written before the enclosure existed.

notebook.label: RESEARCH BOOK
notebook.log: The research notebook separates observations from conclusions and leaves several conclusions unfinished.

books.label: BOOKSHELF
books.log: The shelf connects algorithms, psychology, and travel—the subjects do not stay in separate categories.

board.label: NOTE BOARD
board.log: The board records how she works: research first, test the route, preserve a Plan B, then keep moving.

fieldcase.label: FIELD CASE
fieldcase.log: A rolling field station separates what happens next into NEXT, LATER, and MAYBE—alongside the equipment that can leave the lab.
